newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia July rubber output up 13.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia July rubber output up 13.6 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's output of natural rubber in July increased by 13.6 percent or 11,456 tonnes to 95,846 tonnes over the previous month, the government's Statistics Department said on Saturday.
However, July output was 8.1 percent or 8,408 tonnes lower than in the same month of 1995, the department said in the monthly rubber bulletin.
It said production in the first seven months of this year amounted to 604,336 tonnes, down 10,345 tonnes or 1.7 percent from the year-ago period.
The bulletin said month-on-month exports of natural rubber in July increased 7.9 percent or 5,936 tonnes to 81,106 tonnes, but it was 3.1 percent lower over the same month last year.
Total exports in the first seven months this year dropped to 542,766 tonnes, a decrease of 8.1 percent or 48,001 tonnes over the corresponding period of last year.

Imports of natural rubber for July declined 7.5 percent or 1,804 tonnes to 22,382 tonnes from the preceding month but increased by 26.1 percent or 4,626 tonnes compared with that for the same month in 1995.
Imports in the first seven months this year totalled 154,537 tonnes, up 3.6 percent or 5,381 tonnes over the corresponding 1995 period.
